bureau: credit bureau (ACRA) and the Central Bank credit registry
note: The Central Bank of Armenia's consumer questions: a credit report contains no information more than five years old, and a problem loan leaves it once fully repaid and five years past its last payment. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Central Bank of Armenia, Financial consumer protection: questions for consumers
sources.said: This implies that your credit report will not contain the information on you which is more than five years old. ... if the problem loan is fully repaid, and a period more than five years has lapsed since the last payment
